title.narrative: Enhancing Opportunities for Women and Youth through Literacy and Basic Education

description.narrative: Within the framework of the Lifelong Learning Policy of the Royal Government of Cambodia, UNESCO will support the expansion of alternative and flexible learning pathways for women and out-of-school youth through literacy, skills training and basic education. This programme will be jointly implemented by the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport and the Ministry of Labour and Vocational Training. The linkage between the two programmes will open wider access to non-formal learning opportunities among women and out-of-school youth. It will aim to strengthen the policy environment through conducting policy review and compiling recommendations to accelerate progress towards the government's set ambitions as well as to enhance the linkages between lifelong learning, non-formal education and skills development. The programme will further strengthen the evidence base for literacy and non-formal skills training programmes building a stronger case for both public and private investment. UNESCO is already a well-established and well-respected partner in these sectors and a leading partner for both Ministries. The work will complement existing funding for NFE, skills development and decent employment which is more focused on service delivery, by strengthening the policy environment to sustain these initiatives over the medium to long term.
